//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Welcome Message -> Config

Enable Welcome Message.//: Whether Welcome Message is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

onlyRunOnDedicatedServers.//: If the mod should only run on dedicated servers. When enabled it's not sent when in a singleplayer world.

sendEmptyLineBeforeFirstMessage.//: Whether an empty line should be send before to first message to separate the welcome from other chat messages that might be sent.

messageOneText.//: The first message a player will receive when joining the world. Can be left empty.
messageOneText.value: 欢迎加入这个服务器！/欢迎游玩这个整合包！

messageOneColourIndex.//: 0: black, 1: dark_blue, 2: dark_green, 3: dark_aqua, 4: dark_red, 5: dark_purple, 6: gold, 7: gray, 8: dark_gray, 9: blue, 10: green, 11: aqua, 12: red, 13: light_purple, 14: yellow, 15: white min: 0, max: 15

messageOneOptionalURL.//: If a link is entered here, the complete message will be clickable.
